title: Silvergale's Aria

outfit_card.silhouette: A layered ballgown with an off-shoulder plumed bodice and a voluminous tulle skirt. The dress features an asymmetrical feather shoulder cape and a sweeping floor-length train, evoking an ethereal bird-like form. The sleeves are sheer, fitted from shoulder to wrist.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: An intricate silver tiara with a delicate crescent moon motif, accompanied by winged ear cuffs adorned with soft white feathers and cascading pearl chains.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A structured, strapless corset bodice in ivory silk, overlaid with sheer, embroidered organza. The neckline is adorned with a high, sheer lace collar, while the bodice is embellished with pearl and crystal beadwork. Fitted, sheer lace sleeves extend to the wrists.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A voluminous, multi-tiered tulle ballgown skirt with a feathered hemline. The skirt is gathered at the waist with a metallic silver belt, and the silhouette is completed with a sweeping, embellished train and silver, pointed-toe heels.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Feathery wing-like shoulder accents, a floating crescent moon halo, and scattered iridescent feathers and pearl droplets that hover around the ensemble.
